system.description:
Aquatic Elf

Aquatic elves, also known as sea elves or Pelagiasol elves, dwell beneath the surface of the world's oceans, seas, and large lakes. They are lithe and athletic, with webbed hands and feet and a bluish or green-tinged skin that helps them blend into their aquatic environment. They speak with a lilting, musical accent that mirrors the sound of waves.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Dexterity: +1
  • Constitution: −1

Racial Traits

  • Breathe Water: Aquatic elves can breathe both air and water.
  • Underwater Infravision: 120 feet underwater; no infravision on land.
  • Underwater Movement: Aquatic elves swim at a base movement rate of 12.
  • Resistance to Sleep and Charm: 90% immunity to sleep spells and +2 bonus on saving throws vs. charm and hold spells.
  • Weapon Proficiency Bonus: +1 to attack rolls with trident, spear, and crossbow.
  • Detect Secret Doors: Same as standard elves — 1-in-6 passively, 2-in-6 actively.
  • Armor Restriction: Aquatic elves must wear special underwater or very light armor; they are uncomfortable in heavy, surface-world armors for extended periods out of water.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Magic-User, Thief; Fighter/Magic-User, Fighter/Thief, Magic-User/Thief, Fighter/Magic-User/Thief multiclass.
